title: VeloraOS 1.10.28 - Workspaces, Developer Tools, Git and Knowledge
releaseNotes: Adds private per-account Workspaces with a confined file tree, editor, uploads, search and reviewed writes.
Adds safe test, lint and build tools through a fixed command allowlist with timeouts and no arbitrary shell access.
Adds local Git status, diff, initialization, staging and reviewed commits; Git push is intentionally not included.
Adds a private local Knowledge library with ranked search across text, Markdown, JSON, source files and PDFs when pdftotext is installed.
Adds a unified Workspaces page for project files, tests, Git review and Knowledge search.
Preserves hardware-aware Coding, automatic web research and Lockdown mode.
